text:
incident-bot: ALERT: P99 decode latency spike on us-east-1-gpu-pool. Metric: tail_latency_ms=4890, error_rate=0.2%. Triggered 3123456789
maya: paging @liam @sofia - customers hitting 4–5s tail on generate. multiple timeouts from mobile clients.
liam: on it. logged in, pulling traces.
maya: root cause looks like continuous-batching window grew due to bursty short requests + large seqs. KV-cache churn also high.
ravi: can we temp limit batching to favor latency? propose batch.window_ms=25 -> 10ms.
liam: plan: 1) reduce continuous batching window 2) lower max_batch_tokens 3) enable fast-fail for long queue 4) per-customer rate cap 5) roll back kv-cache prefetch.
sofia: +1. any customer-impacted? list?
maya: verified 3 customers with >1% errors: AcmeCorp, Tutorly, NewsFlash. Noting Acme highest traffic.
elaine: I'm on support, pinged Acme support. They see failed responses from generate API; engineering message ready.
liam: executing changes now. I'll run:
```
redwoodctl runtime set-config --pool us-east-1-gpu-pool --set "continuous_batching.window_ms=25" --set "continuous_batching.enabled=true" --set "batching.max_batch_tokens=512" --set "batching.min_batch_size=1" --set "batching.batch_timeout_ms=30"
```
ops-runner: deploy triggered, job 8853. Rolling out to 3/3 nodes in pool.
incident-bot: Deploy job 8853 started at 3123456820.
liam: also applying rate limit for AcmeCorp: set client_qps(acme)=3
```
redwoodctl quota update --client acme --qps 3 --note "temp mitigate tail latency"
```
sofia: also toggling kv-cache prefetch:
```
redwoodctl runtime set-config --set "kv_cache.prefetch=false"
```
ravi: monitoring dashboards. tail latency dropping to ~450ms at 3123456845.
maya: can we tweak to favor slightly higher throughput? maybe increase window to 30ms after stabilizes.
liam: agree. for now keep aggressive. I'll hand off at 3123456880 to @sofia. @sofia you have the pager.
sofia: taking over. I'll watch error_rate and p95. set alert if p99>800ms for 5m.
elaine: customer update: Acme sees improved success rate. they reported intermittent success. sending note to them.
ops-runner: deploy job 8853 complete on 3/3 nodes at 3123456860.
sofia: p99 stable ~620ms and falling. error_rate back to baseline.
maya: good work. remember to revert per-customer caps and restore batching window after 15min stability.
liam: will create a short runbook entry in incidents channel. quick postmortem later.
incident-bot: If any step needs rollback, run:
```
redwoodctl runtime set-config --pool us-east-1-gpu-pool --set "continuous_batching.window_ms=100" --set "continuous_batching.enabled=true" --set "kv_cache.prefetch=true"
```
sofia: leaving note: handoff to @elaine for customer comms at 3123456895.
elaine: acknowledged, will follow up.
